name: Eggplant lentil bake with cottage cheese

steps.text: Slice the eggplant into rounds, brush with oil and roast at 210°C for 15 minutes.
steps.cue: Slices are golden at the edges and a fork slides in easily.
steps.tip: Use two trays if the slices overlap, or they steam instead of browning.

steps.text: Mix lentils with chopped tomato, onion, oregano and salt and layer with the eggplant in a dish.
Top with cottage cheese and bake at 190°C for 20 minutes.
steps.cue: The cottage cheese is hot with light golden spots and the edges bubble.
